Fixed the missing opening quote on slide 6. Not a typo: the script and the emitted SVG both carried both quotes. ImageMagick 6 lowers each <text> element into an MVG `text x,y "..."` primitive whose payload is itself double-quoted, so a double-quote at the start of the character data collides with that opening delimiter and is dropped; quotes anywhere else survive, which is why the same word renders correctly in the body two lines below. Slide 6 line 3 is the first line in 21 reels to begin with one. render_v3.py gained _payload(), which wraps a payload starting with " in a <tspan> so the quote is no longer first after the delimiter; every other element emits byte-identical SVG. Verified against " (fails identically), a leading zero-width space (works, leaves an invisible character in approved copy) and curly quotes (works, changes the glyph). No word of the approved script changed.
